name: Neon Drift 3D
description: Race down a synthwave highway at sunset: drag to dodge neon barriers and grab glowing orbs.
prompt: A 3D endless racer with three.js in a synthwave style: a neon grid highway, a striped sunset sun, wireframe mountains, a glowing car I steer by dragging, neon barriers to dodge, orbs to collect and speed that keeps rising.
author: gonzaroman
